text_0881d489914e: The route import is at the bottom of Create or edit route knowledge. Open Imported route knowledge (CSV) with +; − collapses the block again. Choose your route CSV. The preview immediately shows matched sections on the map and in the import list without saving. Check the account, data and map. Only Confirm import saves knowledge permanently for your TF account.
